description: How lengths and angles show, as SketchUp's Model Info → Units (saved with the project; metric or imperial itself stays as set): length auto (mm under a metre, else m), mm, cm or m for metric; architectural (feet and inches), feet (decimal) or inches for imperial; decimals (0–3) for decimal lengths; fraction (2–64: 8 is 1/8") for feet and inches; angle_snap (degrees the drawing tools snap angles to, default 15); angle_decimals (0–2). reset goes back to the defaults. Returns the format.
name: set_unit_format
title: Set the unit format
